targetive.ai · a walkthrough for Patrik & Gábor

I run a company with a
team made of software

No big payroll. A handful of AI agents and a library of 100+ skills do the work. Here is how it fits together, and what it can already do.

The shift

I didn't hire a department.
I built one out of agents and skills

Beforeevery task needs a person: write the email, build the list, chase the reply, make the deck
NowI describe the goal, and agents run the right skills to get it done, day and night

The same idea that runs the business also built this deck. One command made it.

The whole thing on one page

The operating system, top to bottom

I set the goal. Jarvis, my main agent, delegates to a small team. They run skills from the library. The skills produce the actual work: finding clients, delivering results, and improving the system itself.

What one command does

A skill in action

/council
Summons a board of seven advisor personas that pressure-test a decision and hand back one clear move.
/deck
Turns a request into an on-brand slide deck. The one you are reading was built this way, start to finish.
Copy Lab
Writes native-grade Hungarian cold email in seconds, in our voice, ready to send.
/aios-build
Describe a tool you wish you had. It plans it, builds it, tests it, and ships it.
The flagship the system runs

targetive.ai — a lead-gen machine
these tools built and operate

Done-for-you cold outbound for Hungarian B2B firms. The agents and skills find the companies, write the emails, handle the replies, and book the meetings. The client just shows up to the calls.

The delivery machine

Signup to booked meeting, on rails

Each step is handled by a skill. The list comes from a 450,000-company database, the copy is written fresh, and a human approves every reply before it goes out.

The part that surprises people

The copy teaches itself

Every email variant is tracked. The system quietly sends more of what is winning and less of what is not, and it pools that learning across all clients. The copy gets better on its own, every week.

hq.targetive.ai / copy-loop

Why it compounds

A flywheel, not a treadmill

Every client makes the next one cheaper to win: the database gets richer, the copy gets smarter, and the proof stack grows. The wheel spins faster without adding people.

The AI-native edge

Mistakes happen once

When something goes wrong or I set a new rule, it gets written into the system, not just fixed in the moment. So the same mistake does not come back, and the whole thing keeps getting sharper.
